label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_01
text: Whoa, whoa! Hold it, you![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_01
text: Up ahead’s the base of operations for Team\nStar’s Dark crew.\c\nYou may know us as the Segin Squad![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_02
text: Yup! And we don’t take too kindly to random\nkids sniffing around our turf.[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_02
text: Sorry, but if you don’t turn yourself around here,\namig[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa, we’ll have to send you packing![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_03
text: Wait, hold up...\c\nJust going on a hunch here, but...are you that\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] kid?[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_04
text: Y’know, that piece of work we’re out to get for\ndeclaring war on Team Star?[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_select_01
text: Maybe I am

label: ajito_aku_010_select_02
text: You’ve got it all wrong!

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_03
text: “Maybe I am,” [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she says. Cool as a cucumber!\nHonesty’s not always the best policy, you know...[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_04
text: Talk about suspicious! That’s exactly what\nsomeone trying to slip under the radar would say![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_05
text:
Ugh, you know what? Doesn’t matter who you
are. You’re not gettin’ through.\c
Buzz off or get thrashed by me in battle, kid.
What’ll it be?[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_select_03
text: I’ll take you on!

label: ajito_aku_010_select_04
text: I’ll get out of your hair...

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_05
text: Have a nice walk back, then! Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_06
text: Graaah! Sassy kids like you are the worst!\nThat’s it—prepare to get stomped into the dirt![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_07
text: Graaah! How the heck could I lose?![VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_08
text: Well, whatever, it’s your problem now! Finish up\nhere for me, would ya, bud?[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_a_09
text: ’K, thanks, hasta la vistaaaaaar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002D)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_06
text: Hasta...la...vi...star... ☆[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_08
text: She’s new to the team, y’know. Might have to\nhave a little chat with her about that attitude...[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_10
text: Well, I’m gonna go into the base now and\ngive the rest of the squad the heads-up.[VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_11
text: We’ll come at you full force if you set foot\ninside, so you might wanna consider turning tail.\r\nEither way, best of luck to you, amig[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]oa![VAR 0x0114(002E)]

label: ajito_aku_010_sitappa_b_12
text: Hasta la vistaaar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
